Repository Guidelines

Source: AGENTS.md

Project Structure & Module Organization

This repository is an R package proof of concept for generating SAS macro test cases from functional requirements. Public package functions live in R/: io.R reads FRD and SAS files, while generate.R builds prompts and provides the optional OpenRouter/ellmer integration. app.R owns the Shiny interface, result normalization, and combined ZIP download. example.R is an offline usage example with assertions. Package metadata and exports are in DESCRIPTION and NAMESPACE; generated API documentation belongs in man/. Dependency versions are managed with renv.lock. PDF/DOCX parsing and SAS execution are outside the current scope. Read ARCHITECTURE.md for current wiring and limits. User guides live in vignettes/; docs/verification.md records observed checks and unverified paths. Prompt with details.md and plan.md retain historical design intent and open requirements; they do not establish implemented behavior.

Build, Test, and Development Commands

Run these from the repository root in R or RStudio:

renv::restore()             # Restore locked dependencies
devtools::load_all(".")    # Load the package for interactive development
source("example.R")        # Exercise the local prompt-generation workflow
devtools::document()        # Generate NAMESPACE and man/ from roxygen comments
pkgdown::check_pkgdown()    # Check article and function reference registration
pkgdown::build_site(preview = FALSE) # Build to pkgdown-site/
shiny::runApp(".")         # Launch the app; live generation needs an API key
devtools::check()           # Run package checks and documentation checks

There is currently no test suite or local build script. When adding tests, place them under tests/testthat/ and run devtools::test() before devtools::check(). Use OPENROUTER_API_KEY through .Renviron for live model calls; never commit credentials or generated sensitive data. Documentation tools are declared in Suggests and included in the explicit renv snapshot. Keep live model calls out of automatically executed examples and vignettes. Record package-check, example, and Chrome DevTools results separately; source inspection is not runtime or SAS validation.

Coding Style & Naming Conventions

Use standard R formatting with four-space indentation, snake_case function and variable names, and explicit package-qualified calls for imported functions (for example, cli::cli_abort()). Keep public functions small and document them with roxygen2 comments; update NAMESPACE and man/ through roxygen2, not by hand. Preserve the existing S3-like object classes (frd_document and sas_macro) when extending the API.

Testing Guidelines

No framework or coverage threshold is configured yet. New behavior should add testthat tests covering successful parsing, malformed or unsupported inputs, prompt construction, and validation errors. Keep tests deterministic by injecting a generator function; do not require network access or an API key in the default test run.

Commit & Pull Request Guidelines

Use concise imperative messages consistent with the existing Git history, such as Add FRD validation. Preserve unrelated uncommitted changes. Pull requests should explain the user-visible or API change, list validation commands and results, identify dependency or lockfile changes, and note any out-of-scope limitations. Include a small reproducible example for changes to prompt or generated-output behavior.
